facts.fact: Eirene 受惊后第一句是找侍女 Tallulah——她怕的是人在屋里受伤；Tallulah 自 Eirene 出生被 Marked 给 Percival 起奉王家之命教导她，久而成 surrogate 母亲
facts.anchor: I was worried sick about you, Lula

facts.fact: 姐妹俩自幼讨厌 Queen Mona（「Miserable Mona」）：Mona 对自认低她一等的人公开轻蔑——她们是「由女仆养大的孩子」；Eirene 与 Percival 婚事变真后其劣迹更无处藏
facts.anchor: I once believed it stemmed from pride in her kingdom

facts.fact: Eirene 转行当媒人：推荐 Alden——被她用「Disgusting」回绝（两人无 romantica 选项）；Eirene 提议「便利婚姻也没什么不好」
facts.anchor: He can save his scandalous love spells for more susceptible ladies

facts.fact: Marked 对她不是诅咒是恐惧：怕无意间杀了他、或更怕早已杀了；梦里他「以某种遥远的方式连着我」——the pull 让她不放弃
facts.anchor: Fear of unknowingly killing him—or worse, fear that I already have—clouds my mind before falling asleep every night

facts.fact: 去年她定下两年期限：找不到就另觅良人——说完才惊觉只剩一年，情绪已被拖垮
facts.anchor: You should know, I decided last year to give him two more years to find me

facts.fact: 真印记稀少、伪造成灾：最恶者出自亲生父母——划伤孩子伪造印记好攀高门（此处违法、Dranderon 据称也违法，但到处都有）——ch01 那个 Marked Match 疤痕男孩的来源
facts.anchor: True marks are somewhat rare but there are countless imitations

facts.fact: 她曾雇 seeker 寻配，花掉的 kildron 远超所值；多年无果解约——不是放弃，是追得太痛
facts.anchor: When I paid the seeker to search for my match

facts.fact: 姐妹印记互为镜像：两线在腕处合流、行于拇指与食指之间——她的线更深；「你会在旅途中自己找到他」是空洞安慰
赠石仪式：她故意装念祝词吓 Eirene，把半宝石质感的火之石（像大号石榴石）放进妹妹手心——「掌中爆炸物」送给 Percy 当礼物
facts.anchor: When it doesn’t blow us to bits, she slowly opens first one eye, then the other

facts.fact: 试炼制度硬设定：仅两枚 Brinden Stone=两个将军空缺；五名竞争者（Ryger、Brant、Alden、Commander Warret…）；Brant 散布「Nash 偏心」流言；Percival 把 Trial One 提到 Brinden Ball 宣誓礼之前以提效
facts.anchor: There are only two Brinden Stones available

facts.fact: 参赛者须弃头衔才能晋升——她弃掉的一切都归 Eirene；「幸好我没多少可弃的」
facts.anchor: Anyone entering the trials must relinquish titles to ascend

facts.fact: 宴会突发：红发灰白、眼神空烧的老人抓住 Eirene 手腕不放——她滑步挡身、左左手套刀出鞘抵喉，割出一线血逼其放手；「她不是你的 Marked，蠢货」；下令押地牢等 Nash 亲自审
facts.anchor: An old man steps abruptly into our path, grabbing Eirene’s right arm

facts.fact: 王家真相：国王与王后是失衡的 Marked Match——被绑定却无温暖；王后能「把人拧成她的意志」，与国王在平衡里互为对手
facts.anchor: The king and queen are an unfortunate Marked Match—bound together, yet clearly mismatched

facts.fact: Alden 顶班「看住公主」：Commander Alden Nash=High General Nash 之子、一起长大从不叫 cousin——「亲近易合、常起冲突、绝无可能成为恋人」；Vina 抢下审讯权：「This is personal」
facts.anchor: Commander Alden Nash moves with the same energy as his father
